Action.title: Action
Action.description: What a user wants to do: one row of the spec's permission matrix (§4.3).

AdminSettingsUpdate.title: AdminSettingsUpdate
AdminSettingsUpdate.description:
The sections to change; each one given replaces that section, and the others are
left as they are.

is_active.title: Is Active
is_active.description: False once deactivated: they cannot sign in.

must_change_password.title: Must Change Password
must_change_password.description: Created with a temporary password they have not changed yet.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; null on the last.

temporary_password.title: Temporary Password
temporary_password.description: Meets the password policy; the user must change it at first sign-in.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: `sent`: the reset link was emailed; `link_for_admin`: it could not be, so it waits in the undelivered links for you to share.

must_change_password.title: Must Change Password
must_change_password.description: True until a user created with a temporary password changes it; until then only this, the password change and signing out are allowed.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether visitors may sign up on their own.

allowed_email_domains.title: Allowed Email Domains
allowed_email_domains.description: Only emails at exactly one of these domains may sign up (a subdomain must be listed itself); empty allows any domain.

open.title: Open
open.description: Whether visitors may sign up on their own.

actor_email.title: Actor Email
actor_email.description: The actor's email, if they are a user.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; null on the last.

security.title: Security
security.description: `none`: plain SMTP; `starttls`: upgrade after connecting (usually port 587); `tls`: TLS from the start (usually 465). Certificates are verified.

username.title: Username
username.description: Leave empty for a server without sign-in.

password.title: Password
password.description: Leave out to keep the saved password; `null` removes it. Changing the host, port or username needs it entered again.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: What the link is for, e.g. `password_reset`.

is_active.title: Is Active
is_active.description: False deactivates the user (their sessions end at once); true reactivates them.

UpdateUserRequest.title: UpdateUserRequest
UpdateUserRequest.description: The changes to make; a field left out stays as it is.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: The Workspace actions you may perform. The UI uses it to show or hide controls; the server checks every request regardless.

version.title: Version
version.description: Send it back when editing; a stale one gets 409.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; null on the last.
